{{Quote|The city's engineers assure us that the race won't have any effect on the city's safety, even if something should go...''wrong'' during the competition.|Race announcer [[Dax Gazaway]] describing the Ballast Complex, the track on which Knire Dark achieved fame|audio=DaxGazBallastComplexCitySafety.flac|<ref name="RR" />}}
'''The Ballast Complex''' was one of two [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] tracks in the city of [[Orotoru G'am]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], and it was the fourth race in the [[Podracing Open]] series. It was named after the big ballast tanks that made the city float on [[Water/Legends|water]]. The track favorite in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] was [[Knire Dark]].<ref name="RR" />
